# osc_eyevinn_python_job_runner (Resource)

Automate your Python workflows effortlessly with Python Job Runner. Clone, install, and execute your scripts in a streamlined, containerized process, perfect for any scheduled tasks on OSC. Enhance productivity today!



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of python-job-runner
- `source_url` (String) URL endpoint for external service

### Optional

- `config_api_key` (String) API key for authentication
- `config_service` (String) Configuration option for configservice
- `git_hub_token` (String) Configuration option for githubtoken
- `osc_access_token` (String) Configuration option for oscaccesstoken
- `worker_cmd` (String)

### Read-Only

- `external_ip` (String) The external Ip of the created instance (if available).
- `external_port` (Number) The external Port of the created instance (if available).
- `instance_url` (String) URL to the created instace
- `service_id` (String) The service id for the created instance
